title: Setting up as a student
blurb: Everything a student does on the first day of class: set up an account and walk away holding an access code.

steps.title: Find your card on the home page
steps.body: Go to the site and pick the card that says "I'm a student." It opens the sign-up form.

steps.title: Fill in your information
steps.body: Three things: your student ID number and last name exactly as they appear on your school ID, then your school email. That is the whole form. If the syllabus should go to an address other than the one your school already has for your family, open "My parent or guardian uses a different email" underneath and put it there.

steps.title: Write down your access code
steps.body: After you submit the form, your own access code is shown once, right there on the screen. Write it down before you go on. This is the only time you will see it, and you need it to come back and finish later.

steps.title: Coming back later
steps.body: Don't go back to the sign-up form -- it will only tell you that you already have an account. Use "Read & initial" instead and sign in with three things: your student ID, your school email, and the access code you wrote down. Everything you already initialed is still there.

steps.title: If you lost your access code
steps.body: It cannot be emailed to you. School and district mail systems block outside senders, so nothing we send would reach your school address. Follow "Don't have a code, or lost it?" on the sign-in page instead and enter a parent or guardian's personal email -- both codes go to that inbox, and they can read yours back to you.
